notes: Company: Silver Helm Assistants — midsize SaaS building outbound SDR chat agents that act inside customers' CRMs and mail/calendar
Primary ask: hosted API for fast ramp, but will likely move to Dedicated if we can't meet p95 latency SLOs under production load

Workload details (from CTO Rafael G.): 80-150 concurrent live agents per region, typical session = streaming chat ~80 tokens initial + tool-calls (CRM lookup + calendar write). Peak burst ~400 reqs/min across region
Latency SLOs: end-to-end agent action (streaming start + CRM tool call roundtrip) target p95 < 300ms; billing-sensitive to token cost — want recommendations on quantization and batching
Tooling: must support function/tool-calling to Salesforce + internal email API + Google Calendar; need webhook reliability and idempotency guarantees
Security: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for admin console, KMS for encryption at rest, audit logs for all tool calls, optional EU residency for a subset of customers
Quote from CPO: "If streaming starts are slow or tool-calls add 200-300ms, SDR conversion drops — can't accept it."

POC notes: used hosted streaming endpoint with mock salesforce proxy. Observed increased p95 when 3rd-party CRM had occasional 150-250ms latency — Redwood routing/fallback discussed (route to fallback model or queue tool-call).
SE suggestions accepted: enable KV prefix caching for agent contexts, reduce max_tokens for system prompts, try int8 quantized variant of Llama-like model for throughput tests

Decision signal: move to Dedicated if Redwood can guarantee sustained p50<150ms and p95<300ms at 150 concurrent sessions with burst to 300 sessions. Also need a pricing SKU that includes baseline reserved capacity + short burst credits
Commercial: requested detailed SKU/pricing deck + security addendum. Legal flagged data residency clause for EU customers. Finance asked for ARR tiering for discounting.
Next operational ask: SE to run a 1-week POC with live CRM integration (Salesforce sandbox) and telemetry capture (token-level latency, per-route errors).
